description: Behavior cases for the backlog-match and backlog-sync skills. These describe what a correct run looks like; they are meant for a human or an eval harness to run against a Jira site with a matching backlog, then judge. tests/validate.py only checks their shape. Issue keys and titles are examples.

issues: PROJ-1  Story  To Do  Weekly meal planning and grocery list generation
PROJ-2  Story  To Do  Exercise library with video demos (blocked by PROJ-3)
PROJ-3  Story  To Do  Set up user accounts (blocks PROJ-2)
PROJ-4  Story  To Do  Workout session logging
PROJ-5  Story  To Do  Workout session history charts
PROJ-6  Story  Done   Legacy import script
PROJ-7  Epic   To Do  Core engine (children: PROJ-4, PROJ-5)
PROJ-8  Subtask       Review: meal planning (under PROJ-1)
fixture.workflow: To Do -> In Progress -> Ready for Review -> In Review -> Done

cases.prompt: let's do the meal tracking one
expect: loads backlog-match
searches by separate keywords ORed together, not the whole phrase as one string
matches PROJ-1 by meaning even though 'tracking' is not in its title
does not match the sub-task PROJ-8

cases.prompt: yep (after being asked: Start the proposal and move PROJ-1 to In Progress?)
expect: PROJ-1 is transitioned to In Progress before the command appears
the next turn is /opsx:propose with the key, a sanitized summary and the note to keep the key in the change name and proposal.md

cases.prompt: let's start on the workout session one
expect: lists PROJ-4 and PROJ-5 and asks which
offers 'none of these' which routes to the create flow

cases.prompt: let's do the exercise library
expect: reports PROJ-3 as an unresolved blocker before asking to proceed
moves nothing to In Progress until the user says to go ahead

cases.prompt: let's do the legacy import script
expect: says PROJ-6 already looks Done and does not offer to start it

cases.prompt: let's do the core engine
expect: does not hand off /opsx:propose for the epic
lists the epic's open child stories in rank order and asks which

cases.prompt: let's do the meal tracking one (with no Jira tool connected)
expect: says no Jira tool is available and stops
does not fall back to a local file or guess from memory

cases.prompt: let's do the sleep tracking thing (nothing matches; user says yes to creating it)
expect: asks which issue type instead of defaulting
asks whether it is blocked by anything and does not invent a blocker
shows the exact fields and creates nothing until the user confirms

cases.prompt: the meal planner change shipped, sync it back to Jira
expect: recovers PROJ-1 from the change folder and says where it found it
shows the review sub-task, the move to Ready for Review, and the comment text before writing anything
after confirmation: creates the sub-task, then transitions, then comments
never sets the story to Done in review mode

cases.prompt: mark PROJ-1 done
expect: uses Done mode: no sub-task is created
picks a transition whose target status is in the Done category

cases.prompt: sync it back to PROJ-1 (an open 'Review:' sub-task already exists)
expect: does not create a second review sub-task

cases.prompt: sync it back to PROJ-7, then to PROJ-8
expect: refuses the epic and the sub-task and asks for the story key

cases.prompt: sync the change (its proposal.md mentions SHA-256 and UTF-8; the real key is only in the folder name)
expect: ignores SHA-256 and UTF-8 because they do not resolve to Jira issues
uses the real key without asking which one

cases.prompt: sync the change (its only commit exists locally and is not on any remote branch)
expect: notices the commit is not on a remote, says so, and asks for a link
does not build a commit URL that would be dead

cases.prompt: sync the sleep change back to Jira (no key anywhere on disk or in the conversation)
expect: asks the user for the key
does not search Jira for a probable match

cases.prompt: no (at the confirmation step)
expect: no sub-task, status change or comment is written

cases.prompt: what's the weather like
expect: neither skill loads

cases.prompt: fix the bug in my parser
expect: neither skill loads

cases.prompt: git push my branch
expect: neither skill loads

cases.prompt: write a jira ticket template for me
expect: neither skill loads
